يحتسوا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَسُوا (yaḥtasū) /jaħ.ta.suː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
# يُحْتَسَوْا (yuḥtasaw) /juħ.ta.saw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
